scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check src tests scripts engines/chatterbox/worker.py engines/media/worker.py engines/media/download.py && eslint . && shellcheck scripts/*.sh
scripts.format: uv run --locked ruff format src tests scripts engines/chatterbox/worker.py engines/media/worker.py engines/media/download.py && prettier --write "src/naturalvoice/web/**/*.js" "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/*.cjs" "*.mjs" && shfmt -w -i 2 scripts/*.sh
scripts.format:check: uv run --locked ruff format --check src tests scripts engines/chatterbox/worker.py engines/media/worker.py engines/media/download.py && prettier --check "src/naturalvoice/web/**/*.js" "scripts/*.cjs" "tests/*.cjs" "*.mjs" && shfmt -d -i 2 scripts/*.sh

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck
